name: Auto Shops
title: Field Sales Team for Auto Shops | Our Wellness Network
description: Our field team visits the car washes, parts stores and dealerships near your auto shop in Lombard, Elmhurst or Oak Brook and turns them into a referral network you can track.
cardBlurb: We visit the car washes, parts stores and dealerships near your shop and build a network you can track.
intro: We visit the businesses drivers already stop at near your auto shop, build relationships with their staff and turn them into a referral network you can track. Every stop and every sign-up shows up in your portal.
partnersIntro: Drivers stop at these businesses all the time, and the staff there are who they ask when a car starts making a new noise.

partners.name: Car washes
partners.why: Drivers who look after their cars come through often, and the crew sees what shape those cars are in.

partners.name: Car dealerships
partners.why: Buyers, especially of used cars past their warranty, need a shop they trust close to home.

partners.name: Auto parts stores
partners.why: Do-it-yourselfers come in for parts and sometimes find out the job is bigger than the driveway.

partners.name: Gas stations
partners.why: Drivers ask the counter staff where to go when a warning light comes on.

partners.name: Towing companies
partners.why: Every tow ends with the same question: where should the car go?

partners.name: Driving schools
partners.why: New drivers and their parents need a shop they can trust for a first car.

treatsIntro: On every visit, our field team brings coffee and treats for the whole staff at each partner business, from the front counter to the crew out back. It's simple hospitality, it's included in your plan, and it's the reason crews are glad to see us pull in.
treatExamples: Coffee and donuts for a parts counter's morning crew
Snacks and coffee for a car wash crew before the Saturday rush
Muffins and coffee for a towing company's early dispatchers
portalNote: In your portal you see every stop we make for your shop and every sign-up that comes through a partner's code, ready for your service desk to call and book. It's how you see which partnerships are working, business by business.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing bays
notes.text: Our matching software leaves other repair shops off your route, and we skip any business you already work with, like the tow company you already call, unless you ask.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We describe your shop only in words you've approved, and we leave only the printed materials you've signed off on.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one auto shop like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Will you visit other repair shops near me?
faq.a: No. Our matching software ranks the businesses near you that share your customers and don't compete with you. You approve the list before we visit anyone.

faq.q: Dealerships have their own service departments. Why would you visit one?
faq.a: Only if our matching software ranks it as sharing your customers without competing with you, and only if you approve it. If you'd rather leave dealerships off your route, we leave them off.

faq.q: How do sign-ups reach my service desk?
faq.a: Every sign-up shows up in your portal with the business and staff member whose code it came through, ready for your team to call and book. It also shows you which partnerships are working, stop by stop.
